sample_handling: Check for right-censored observations in the dataset
Verify temporal coverage of historical data
Identify incomplete observations with missing outcomes
missing_data_strategy: Investigate missingness patterns for all columns
Determine if missing data is random or systematic
Assess impact of missing data on model assumptions

validation.rationale: The prediction task involves time-series data where future observations are not available at prediction time. Temporal holdout ensures that the validation set consists of future observations relative to the training set.

baselines.name: naive_mean
baselines.purpose: Provide a baseline for continuous targets using the mean of the historical data

baselines.name: naive_median
baselines.purpose: Provide a baseline for continuous targets using the median of the historical data

candidate_models.name: linear_regression
candidate_models.rationale: Linear regression with regularization (e.g., L1 or L2) is a standard starting point for interpretable models. It can handle linear relationships and regularization to prevent overfitting.

candidate_models.name: random_forest
candidate_models.rationale: Random forests are robust to noise and can capture non-linear relationships. They are a common benchmark for tree-based models.

metrics.name: mse
metrics.rationale: Mean squared error is appropriate for continuous targets and provides a measure of prediction error.

metrics.name: r2
metrics.rationale: R-squared measures the proportion of variance explained by the model, which is useful for interpretability.

diagnostics: Residual analysis for linearity and homoscedasticity
Assess model stability across different temporal splits
interactions_to_investigate: Interaction between time-based features and economic indicators
Interaction between project size and market conditions

censoring.note: Incomplete observations with missing outcomes should be handled as right-censored observations to avoid bias in the model.

unresolved_questions: Do we have sufficient historical data to train a model without right-censoring?
Are there any time-dependent features that are not yet available at prediction time?
handoff: The model development process should proceed with the temporal holdout validation strategy, starting with the naive baselines and moving to the candidate models.
